# @sharadox/icon-web-library

> Line icons for every Sharadox site: one React component, drawn on a 24 grid in the current color.

- icon Icon({ name, label?, strokeWidth? = 1.5, className? }): svg 1em square, stroke currentColor, round caps; aria-hidden unless label (then role img)
- icon-path ICON_PATHS: chevron-left, chevron-right, chevron-up, chevron-down, close, expand, zoom-in, call, sms, whatsapp, email, directions, sun, cookie
- Rule: no text arrows (→ ↑ ×) on any site; use these chevrons and icons
- 0.1.0: first release
- 0.2.0: sun
- 0.3.0: check (a tick: done, included)
- 0.5.0: document-check, euro, package, truck, wrench, bolt, pointer (fill it for a solid mouse pointer)
- 0.4.0: BrandIcon and BRAND_ICON_PATHS (filled brand marks: facebook, instagram, tiktok, youtube, x, threads, pinterest, linkedin, google; Simple Icons CC0, LinkedIn drawn here)
- 0.6.0: flag Flag({ country, label?, className? }): a country's flag by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, svg 1.5em × 1em (3:2, slice); flag-svg FLAG_SVGS (245 countries with a phone calling code, { viewBox, body }) and type FlagCountry; from country-flag-icons (MIT, NOTICE.md); ~47 KB gzipped, import only where flags show
